limitations.note: The rewrite aligned the outputs by making them report the new count rather than the pre-edge count, exposing increments and set values one cycle earlier than intended and changing the reset value of `zero` from 0 to 1.

The test expected each increment or set value on the same edge and derived `zero` solely from the expected number, so it passed the rewrite without checking the intended one-cycle output delay or the low reset value of `zero`.
